# Ling Fin frozen scientific batch gate

**Disposition:** reject this exact Ling Fin/Novita configuration as a scientific standby under the [frozen rule](ling-fin-qualification-prereg-v1.json). All three completed trials missed the same partial-support label. This is a repeatable completed quality failure, rather than an inconclusive transport or rate-limit result. No citation, usefulness, ranking, default switch, or production deployment follows.

The [interface panel](ling-fin-interface-assessment-v1.md) passed before this stage. The [fresh public admission](ling-fin-batch-admission-v1.json) at 2026-09-26 10:01 UTC found the exact Novita endpoint available at zero prompt/completion price and in OpenRouter's ZDR inventory. Its per-request price was not published; each actual request therefore carried binding zero prompt/completion/request caps. Before each trial, the launcher verified the committed preregistration's fixed SHA256, 49 pinned source/input hashes and 606 project source hashes. Each trial ran in a fresh credential-isolated process at the unchanged commit `62aa6701`, with one physical-request ceiling and a new exclusive artifact.

| Trial | Observed labels, in frozen order | Requests | Result |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- |
| [1](ling-fin-batch-v1-1.json) | insufficient, supports, insufficient, contradicts | 1 | Completed; first label wrong |
| [2](ling-fin-batch-v1-2.json) | insufficient, supports, insufficient, contradicts | 1 | Completed; same first-label error |
| [3](ling-fin-batch-v1-3.json) | insufficient, supports, insufficient, contradicts | 1 | Completed; same first-label error |

The [frozen four-claim input](batch-schema-preflight109.json) requires **partial, supports, insufficient, contradicts**. The first claim says compound R reduced lipid accumulation **and** restored insulin sensitivity in adult hepatocytes. Its passage reports the lipid result but says insulin sensitivity was not measured. Every raw model response labeled that claim `insufficient` while quoting the partially supportive passage; the production batch assessor preserved that label. The retained [Nex Pro comparator](batch-context120-acceptance.json) labeled the same public case `partial` in all three runs. Every other final label matched the control. In trials 2 and 3, the second claim's supporting quote came from another item in the same frozen passage pool and states that migration decreased; it remains verbatim and substantively supporting. The contradiction result's `lexical_founded` method is the existing post-processing guard also present in the M1 comparator, not a deterministic assessor fallback.

Every physical request named the exact Fin route, pinned Novita as the only provider, disabled fallbacks, required supported parameters, denied data collection, requested ZDR, and capped prompt, completion and request prices at zero. Every response reported the exact served Fin model, positive prompt/completion usage, `cost: 0.0`, no recorded fallback, and no unobserved or unpriced call. Those fields are provider/application telemetry, not an independent billing statement. There was no terminal error, 429 or retry. The fixed configuration and source hashes were unchanged across trials; no selective rerun or post-hoc threshold change was made.

An independent Luna 6 xhigh audit confirmed the repeated raw-model first-label error, complete trials, request controls and conditional stop. It flagged the cross-item quote in trials 2 and 3 as a possible false support because the source item's ID contains “contradiction.” The quoted sentence itself says migration **decreased**, which supports this claim's “reduces migration”; its ID describes its role for the separate “increases migration” control. The assessment uses the quote text and claim polarity, rather than the source item's name.

The preregistered batch gate requires all four exact labels in **every** trial and a model-grounded quote. Three completed 3/4 trials fail it. The preregistered rejection rule covers repeatable completed scientific failure, so this exact candidate is rejected for production qualification. The primary operational target remains zero independently qualified standby routes. Conditional citation, usefulness and ranking panels were not launched, and no claim about their performance follows. A future materially different model, prompt or assessor would need a new preregistration and a complete comparison, not a replacement trial inserted into this series.
